purpose: Independently certify append-only production snapshot lineage without opening labels, outcomes, prediction values, or candidate payloads.
inputs: prior immutable snapshot root and expected SHA-256
current immutable snapshot root and expected SHA-256
required_invariants: Each snapshot SHA equals the SHA-256 of its SHA256SUMS payload manifest and every listed payload hash verifies.
The prior transaction registry is an exact byte prefix of the current transaction registry.
The intake and score registry projections are independently reconstructed from transactions and each prior projection is an exact byte prefix of the current projection.
Historical transaction rows are byte-preserved; archive SHA, archive path, and drop ID remain globally unique.
Current structural inventory is component-wise nondecreasing for physical runs, eligible runs, endpoints, structural pairs, and tasks.
Runner transaction count and accumulator blindness receipts match the current registry.
claim_boundary: This receipt supports immutable version lineage and schema-evolution auditability only; it is not evidence of predictor quality, scaling, or search utility.
